_meta.source: soundtap.com (defunct), recovered from the Internet Archive
_meta.note: Stream URLs are NOT included and are not recoverable from the archive: SoundTap served them from /stationdata/<id>/, which the Wayback Machine never captured, and the public station edit form deliberately omitted the field. Names, slugs and coordinates are complete; location/homepage/status are present only for stations enriched before archive.org rate-limited the harvest. Resume enrichment with scripts/harvest-soundtap.py.
